<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sound Out 04 · Play an Instrument</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #141414;
    }
    canvas {
      touch-action: none; /* a finger on the canvas never scrolls the page */
    }
  </style>

  <!-- a laptop has no tilt sensor but still sends one empty reading. ignore it, so rotationX stays a number -->
  <script>
    window.addEventListener('deviceorientation', function (e) {
      if (e.beta === null) e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
  </script>

  <!-- p5.js 2.x -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2.2.3/lib/p5.js"></script>

  <!-- p5-phone: the permission tap, the gesture lock, the sensors and the flashlight -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5-phone@1.15.0/dist/p5-phone.min.js"></script>

  <!-- on a laptop, a QR code of this page, to open it on a phone. only on the https examples site -->
  <script>
    if (location.protocol === 'https:' && window.self === window.top) {
      addEventListener('load', function () { showDesktopQr(); });
    }
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="sketch.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
